project.title: Ozone
project.description: This music video is inspired by the fire tragedy that happened at the Ozone Disco Club in 1996. This tragedy is recognized as the worst fire in Philippine history. It was a result of negligence and disregard for safety regulations. The music video implicitly critiques societal disregard for safety measures and the consequences of prioritizing profit over human well-being.
